## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
The merged Opum facade writes its quest request including the claimOrCorrelation transport field to stdin, while the domain contract validates exactly the normative four-key envelope (contract, supportedVersions, requestId, taskId) and rejects the extra field, so every live opum work start fails at the Quest records stage (OPUM_WORKFLOW_QUEST_ABSENT/INCOMPATIBLE). Extract the correlation reference at the CLI transport boundary, validate the normative envelope through the existing domain contract unchanged, and ship as the minimum 0.2.8 patch so the deployed facade can bind eligible Quest tasks. The stale field-installed 0.2.7 build without this routing is replaced by the fresh candidate; the user owns all registry writes.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->

## Acceptance Criteria
<!-- AC:BEGIN -->
- [x] #1 Exact normative four-key stdin envelope binds an eligible in-progress task with an active claim or accepted/delivered/working correlation, printing the stable v1 stdout envelope on stdout and nothing on stderr
- [x] #2 The facade-shaped request carrying claimOrCorrelation binds identically; the correlation reference feeds the relationship lookup without weakening domain validation
- [x] #3 Unknown contracts or versions, malformed envelopes, and unknown extra fields fail stderr-only with stable OPUM_WORKFLOW_QUEST_INCOMPATIBLE; missing/terminal/stale/mismatched relationships fail OPUM_WORKFLOW_QUEST_ABSENT or OPUM_WORKFLOW_QUEST_STATE with empty stdout
- [x] #4 Backlog import/adopt and all existing task binding behavior are preserved; the repository check suite is green
- [x] #5 Delivered as the minimum Quest 0.2.8 patch candidate: independent two-axis review, checked PR merged to dev, seven-package candidate qualified platform-first/root-last with provenance metadata, fresh byte-binding dry-run, and clean installed-CLI smoke, with zero registry writes by the Worker
<!-- AC:END -->
